subject.title: fix(gateway): deliver OAuth authorization URLs to non-terminal clients

question: Should OpenClaw accept `presentsAuthChallenge` as a WizardPrompter/provider-auth contract that makes RPC auth-presenting clients receive OAuth challenges in-band and use manual-style auth behavior?
rationale: The code path fixes a real non-terminal OAuth gap, but it changes plugin-facing prompter semantics and provider auth routing rather than only adding prompt text.

options.title: Accept After Proof And Rebase
options.body: Accept the new prompter capability and routing once the contributor adds inspectable companion proof and rebases the branch cleanly.

options.title: Narrow To Prompt Text Only
options.body: Ask for a replacement that keeps host locality separate and only threads the authorization URL into prompt messages where already manual.

options.title: Defer To RPC Parity Umbrella
options.body: Pause this PR and decide the auth-challenge contract together with the broader wizard RPC parity work.

recommendation.title: Accept After Proof And Rebase
recommendation.body: Accept the new prompter capability and routing once the contributor adds inspectable companion proof and rebases the branch cleanly.

likelyOwner.reason: Provider auth helper and auth-choice history makes this the strongest available routing owner for the contract decision.
